story.iWant: I want to merge fixture data from multiple sources into a unified format

tasks.task: Review existing Fixture and data models (AC: #1, #2, #6)
Implement conflict resolution and source tracking (AC: #4, #7)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Implement `consolidate_fixtures()` function that accepts raw fixture list from `fetch_all_data()`
Merge API-Football + ESPN + scrape data into single `Fixture` objects
Handle conflicting data by preferring fresher source (track timestamps for all data points)
Normalize all fields to standard format matching `Fixture` Pydantic model
Return list of `Fixture` objects with complete metadata including source lineage
Preserve all original data sources for auditability (don't discard secondary sources)
Handle edge case: fixture missing optional data (form, injuries, odds) - continue with partial data
Handle edge case: conflicting data from different sources - log warning and prefer fresher
Return `list[Fixture]` with data quality metadata attached to each fixture

doc.title: Technical Specification - System Architecture
doc.snippet: Data consolidation specification: Purpose is to normalize data from multiple sources into unified schema with modules normalizer.py, validator.py, merger.py. Key responsibility: Take messy data from 3+ sources → output clean `Fixture[]` with consistent fields. Data quality rules: Reject odds > 1h stale, Reject injuries > 12h stale, Accept form up to 24h, H2H is static.

doc.title: Technical Specification - Error Handling Strategy
doc.snippet: API Failures use try/except patterns with custom exceptions. Data Quality Issues checked with timedelta comparisons (odds_age > 1h, injuries_missing). OpenAI Failures use RateLimitError and APIError handling. All following CLAUDE.md patterns for structured error handling.

doc.title: Story 2.5 - Graceful Degradation for Data Sources
doc.snippet: fetch_all_data() returns dict with: fixtures (list), form_data (dict keyed by team_id), injuries (dict keyed by team_id), odds (dict keyed by fixture_id), h2h (dict keyed by fixture_id). All data pre-validated by individual fetchers. Missing data represented as: [] (empty list) or None (not found).

artifact.reason: Core data model that consolidation layer must populate. Defines all fields: fixture_id, kickoff_time, home_team, away_team, league, odds, head_to_head_history. Includes Pydantic validators for field validation.
Team model used within Fixture. Defines: id, name, form_5_games, avg_goals_for, avg_goals_against, injuries list. Consolidation must populate these for both home and away teams.
League model used within Fixture. Defines: league_id, league_name, league_country, league_season. Must be populated from API-Football fixture data during consolidation.
Form data model from fetch_all_data(). Consolidation merges this into Fixture.home_team and Fixture.away_team form fields.
Injury model from fetch_all_data(). Consolidation merges list of injuries into Fixture.home_team.injuries and Fixture.away_team.injuries.
Odds model from fetch_all_data(). Consolidation merges into Fixture.odds field which stores dict[str, dict[str, float]] (market -> {outcome: odds}).
Output of Story 2.5. Consolidation receives this dict structure with fixtures, form_data, injuries, odds, h2h keys. Understanding this output format is critical for mapping to Fixture model.
Individual fetcher functions called by fetch_all_data(). Consolidation layer doesn't call these directly but needs to understand their return types and structure to properly merge their output.
Exception hierarchy for consolidation error handling. AC#12 requires try/except to log on failures and skip fixtures. Use ConsolidationError for critical consolidation failures.

python.package: For Pydantic BaseModel and validators - already installed
Native Python async library - no install needed
Native Python logging module - no install needed
Native Python type hints - no install needed

constraints.constraint: Follow CLAUDE.md Error Handling - Mandatory Patterns (CLAUDE.md #3): All API errors must use custom exception hierarchy, log with context, never swallow silently.
Follow CLAUDE.md Async/Await Patterns (CLAUDE.md #1): Mark consolidate_fixtures() as async for consistency with rest of pipeline, though no blocking I/O calls are expected.
Input structure must match fetch_all_data() output from Story 2.5: dict with keys fixtures, form_data, injuries, odds, h2h. Missing sources represented as empty list [] or None.
Output must be list[Fixture] where each Fixture has complete metadata. Cannot return partial structures - use Pydantic model validation to ensure all required fields are populated.

Source preference logic from technical-spec.md: API-Football is always primary for fixtures/injuries/odds/h2h. Form uses API-Football primary with ESPN fallback (already tracked by fetch_all_data()). Conflicts resolved by timestamp (prefer fresher data).

Data freshness rules from technical-spec.md: Odds > 1h stale should be flagged (but not rejected - Story 3.2 validates). Injuries > 12h stale should be flagged. Form data up to 24h is acceptable. H2H is static (no freshness check).

Create new directory `/src/bet_bot/data/consolidation/` with: __init__.py (exports consolidate_fixtures), consolidator.py (main logic), merger.py (data merging utilities). No changes to existing fetcher modules.
Consolidation output feeds into Story 3.2 (data freshness validation) and Story 3.3 (quality scoring). Must preserve all source metadata for these downstream consumers to assess data quality.
Never crash pipeline on individual fixture consolidation failure. Log exception, skip that fixture, continue with others. Only raise ConsolidationError if ALL fixtures fail (critical failure).
Use underscore prefix for internal helper functions: _merge_form_data(), _resolve_conflict(), _track_source() etc. Public API is only consolidate_fixtures().

interface.name: consolidate_fixtures
interface.signature: async def consolidate_fixtures(raw_data: dict[str, Any], fixture_list: list[dict]) -> list[Fixture]
interface.description: Main consolidation orchestration function. Accepts raw output from fetch_all_data() and original fixture list from API-Football, returns list of Fixture objects with all fields populated and source metadata tracked.

interface.name: fetch_all_data
interface.description: Upstream function (Story 2.5) that provides input dict with keys: fixtures, form_data, injuries, odds, h2h. Consolidation receives this and normalizes it to Fixture model.

interface.name: Fixture (model)
interface.signature: class Fixture(BaseModel): fixture_id, kickoff_time, home_team, away_team, league, odds, head_to_head_history
interface.description: Target data model for consolidation. All consolidation logic must populate Fixture instances to match this schema exactly.

tests.standards: Unit tests follow pytest patterns established in stories 2.1-2.5. Use unittest.mock for mocking API responses and Pydantic models. Async tests decorated with @pytest.mark.asyncio. Test both success and failure paths. Verify logging at appropriate levels (INFO for success, WARNING for fallback/partial data, CRITICAL for halt). Pydantic model instantiation must be actual (not mocked) to catch validation errors early.
tests.locations: tests/unit/test_consolidator.py (new file for this story). Reference existing test patterns in tests/unit/test_graceful_degradation.py and tests/unit/test_api_football.py for async test structure and mocking patterns.

ideas.idea: Test consolidate_fixtures() with all sources succeeding: Mock API-Football fixture list (2-3 fixtures), mock form_data/injuries/odds from fetch_all_data(), verify all fields populated in result Fixtures, verify source_lineage tracked correctly
Test with missing optional data: Mock with no form_data, no injuries, no odds separately. Verify consolidation continues, missing fields handled gracefully (empty list or None as appropriate)
Test with partial data: Mock injuries partial (2/4 teams have injuries). Verify result includes empty list for missing teams, logs warning
Test source conflict resolution: Mock API-Football form older than ESPN form (timestamp comparison). Verify ESPN form used, logged as primary source preference
Test error handling: Mock malformed fixture data (missing required fields). Verify error logged, fixture skipped, consolidation continues with remaining fixtures
Test edge case: fixture with no data at all. Verify ConsolidationError raised only if ALL fixtures fail, not for individual fixture failures
Test data quality metadata: Verify each Fixture has source_lineage attached with timestamps and source names for downstream Story 3.2/3.3 validation
Test field normalization: Verify all API-Football nested structures (teams.home, teams.away, league.name) properly extracted and normalized to Team and League objects
